title: A PING ON THE OVERSEER NAMES IT
why: A ping on THE OVERSEER said WARDEN, in both windows, while the boss bar and the kill feed name it. A ping now names a pillager or THE OVERSEER by name (a linked window knows the boss by its name only) and any other body by its kind, as before.
now: A ping on THE OVERSEER now names it instead of WARDEN.

edits.replacement: m={t:'png',x:Math.round(hit?hit.x:w.x),y:Math.round(hit?hit.y:w.y),w:hit?netPingName(hit):''};   // v16.xx: the boss by its name
